items.title: 29.5.2 Ahem functional groups ke IR spectra (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the IR spectra of functional groups (PDF 193-195).

items: Alcohols: O-H group 3200-3600 cm-1 par tez, chauri absorption deta hai (jaise butan-2-ol mein); taqreeban 3000 cm-1 ka band sp3 C-H bonds se hai.

blocks.alt: 2-Butanol, CH3CH(OH)CH2CH3, ka IR spectrum: % transmittance (0 se 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 400). 3350 ke qareeb bohat chaura, gehra band O-H ke naam se nishan zada hai; 2950 ke qareeb nokeele C-H bands aur 1500 se neeche bohat se bands.
blocks.caption: 2-Butanol ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Amines: N-H bond taqreeban 3300 aur 3400 cm-1 par do kamzor absorptions deta hai (jaise octylamine mein). Amine mein N-H signal chaura hai, lekin alcohol ke O-H signal se zyada chaura nahi.

blocks.alt: Octylamine, CH3(CH2)7NH2, ka IR spectrum: % transmittance aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 400). 3370 aur 3290 ke qareeb do chhote, kamzor jhukao N-H ke naam se nishan zada; 2900 ke qareeb bohat tez C-H bands aur 1600, 1470 aur 800 ke qareeb mazeed bands.
blocks.caption: Octylamine ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Amides: N-H aur C=O dono ke liye 1500 cm-1 se oopar absorptions; N-H (do peaks) taqreeban 3200 aur 3400 cm-1 par aur C=O taqreeban 1660 cm-1 par (jaise propanamide mein).

blocks.alt: Propanamide, CH3CH2CONH2, ka IR spectrum: % transmittance aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 400). 3350 aur 3180 ke qareeb do tez jhukao N-H ke naam se, aur 1650 ke qareeb bohat tez band C=O ke naam se nishan zada; 1450 aur 1100 ke darmiyan mazeed nokeele bands.
blocks.caption: Propanamide ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Carboxylic acids: C=O taqreeban 1700 cm-1 par tez absorption, saath 2500 aur 3300 cm-1 ke darmiyan chauri, gehri O-H absorption, jis ka daen hissa aksar C-H peaks se bigar jata hai.

blocks.alt: Carboxylic acid ka IR spectrum: absorbance / % (oopar 0, neeche 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 500). Taqreeban 3700 se 2500 tak bohat chaura, gehra band, 3100 ke qareeb sab se gehra, jis ke daen hisse par chhote C-H ubhaar hain; 1750 ke qareeb bohat tez band aur 1450 aur 600 ke darmiyan kai tez bands.
blocks.caption: Carboxylic acid ka IR spectrum (29.5.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Do infrared spectra, A (oopar) aur B (neeche), dono absorbance / % (oopar 0, neeche 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 500) par. A mein 3450 ke qareeb chhota jhukao, 3000 ke qareeb tez band aur 1750 ke qareeb bohat tez, nokeela band, phir 1500 se neeche kai bands. B mein 3350 ke qareeb bohat chaura, gehra band, 2950 ke qareeb tez bands aur 1500 se neeche bohat se bands.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 29.2 (IR): infrared spectra A aur B (kitab yahan Misal 29.1 wale spectra dobara chhapti hai; asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Neeche ke do infrared spectra (A aur B) mein se kaun sa butanone aur kaun sa butan-2-ol ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Jis spectrum mein taqreeban 1700-1720 cm-1 par nokeela, tez band aur 3200-3600 cm-1 par chaura band nahi woh butanone hai (chhapa spectrum A); jis mein 3200-3600 cm-1 par chaura O-H band aur C=O band nahi woh butan-2-ol hai (spectrum B).

blocks.alt: Do IR spectra, IR Spectra for Compound T (oopar) aur IR Spectra for Compound U (neeche), dono transmittance % (0 se 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se taqreeban 400). T mein taqreeban 3500 se 2500 tak bohat chaura jhukao, 3000 ke qareeb sab se gehra, 1780 ke qareeb bohat tez band aur 1600 se neeche bohat se bands. U ki buniyadi lakeer taqreeban 80 % par seedhi, 2950 ke qareeb chhote bands, 1740 ke qareeb bohat tez band aur 1450, 1370, 1240 aur 1050 ke qareeb tez bands.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 29.2 (IR): compounds T aur U ke IR spectra (Quick Check mein chhape spectra ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Compounds T aur U ke molecular formula C3H6O2 hain (yeh isomers hain). Neeche diye gaye spectra ki bunyad par in ki banawatein tajweez karein.
blocks.explanation: T carboxylic acid hai: propanoic acid, CH3CH2COOH. U ester hai (C=O lekin O-H nahi): methyl ethanoate, CH3COOCH3, ya ethyl methanoate, HCOOCH2CH3. (Bands chhape spectra se parhe gaye.)

items: Alcohol O-H 3200-3600 par chaura; amine N-H 3300 aur 3400 ke qareeb kamzor.
Amide: N-H (do) aur taqreeban 1660 par C=O; tezaab: taqreeban 1700 par C=O aur 2500-3300 par bohat chaura O-H.
